unresolvedInterpretation: Lane scope: 39109740879 is a desk-lane whole set. The clauses of L246 and L253 say 'whole-set runs' without a lane or source limit, and the earlier audit's nine counted sets were also other lanes' final/landing gates, so counting it is consistent; if the architect limits counted sets to MAWS-app lanes or to F-owned trees, L246 stays 4/5 and L253 stays 9/10.

Red whole sets: the audit counted sets with 3-6 unrelated reds (e.g. e3-final 5 reds) for L246/L253 (the clause is about the one case / the one stall signature), and did not require the reds to be relaunched green. 39109740879 follows that precedent exactly.

Source-change reset: the L253 row names teardown surfaces (launch.ts closeOrKill, processes.ts, shutdown/quit-guard). W-T's L265 commit 3dff5766f edits launch.ts cleanup() and processes.ts after closeOrKill, not closeOrKill; 39109740879's source predates it. The L253 clause has no reset rule (the 'any corrective source change restarts the streak' sentence in the plan is scoped to the MINI baseline wave); whether F's own teardown edit should make the tenth count come from the frozen-source p3f-final whole set is the architect's call. If so, the p3f-final gate is the 10th for L253 and the 5th for L246 with this audit's method.

L90 needs a per-run load reading below 20; CI job logs carry none (no load line in the c7 job). The mini's own recorded loads in F-span measurement runs were 2.5-6.4, which suggests the lane is far below 20 but is not a reading for any c7 run.
L253's stall-signature check follows the earlier audit (red job logs only). Green jobs cannot contain the stall because the poll timeout fails the test.
